No bug that makes the result meaningless. The penalty hop optimises centres and radii together, then clips the centres to the square and repairs the radii. Every fifth accepted hop gets an SLSQP polish, and that result also goes through clip and repair. A hop is kept only if the repaired sum of radii goes up.

The search is weaker than before, though not invalid. HOP_W = 1e-3 rewards larger radii only weakly, so L-BFGS-B ends with small overlaps that _repair removes by shrinking radii. L-BFGS-B also has no analytic gradient, so it estimates one with about 97 energy calls per step. As a result, most hops probably score below the incumbent best and are rejected. This fits the lower score.
Timing risk is small. The budget is checked only at the top of the loop, so one SLSQP polish can run past the 0.8 × 30 = 24 s budget. That still leaves a wide margin before the 45 s limit.

Mirrored circles can overlap or land outside the square, but SLSQP and the later repair step deal with that. The harness also checks validity exactly, and it raised no integrity flags.

Recomputed z = (2.9375 - 2.9370) / (0.0034 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) = 0.0005 / 0.00416 ≈ 0.12. This agrees with the harness value of 0.125 within rounding. The 0.0005 gain is well inside the noise (sd 0.0034), so rejecting is justified.

Note: the candidate's 2.9375 and the incumbent's 2.9370 both match or slightly beat the stated published best of about 2.9370. The difference is far smaller than the noise and the harness checks every packing exactly, so this is not suspicious. Still, either the published figure is a little low or these runs were lucky.
The candidate has only 1 run, so a replicate would be needed before any claim of improvement.

description: Adds a cut-and-reflect move to basin hopping: with probability 0.25 a random line through the square is drawn, circle centres on one side are mirrored across it and clipped to the square, and the existing Gaussian hop is used otherwise.
Runs each restart-phase SLSQP in three stages with radius upper bounds annealed 0.12, then 0.3464 (about sqrt(0.12)), then uncapped, so many circles settle before any one grows large.
